messages:
marta-m: Quick ping 00  I sketched a new battlecard angle: 'Serving guardrails' vs cloud APIs and DIY infra. Focus: one defensible perf stat, a procurement-safe TCO bullet, and a short webinar run that demonstrates fallbacks. Feedback?

priya-k: Love the framing. Draft uploaded: https://redwood.internal/mkt/bcards/serving-guardrails-v1 (pls comment). Suggest we lead with a single p99 claim + link to a reproducibility appendix. Keep the AE elevator <200 chars.

sam-g: Sales asks for an elevator and a quick soundbite for calls. If Jon can confirm a ~3x p99 ratio on long-form convs we can use: "~3x lower p99 on long-form prompts vs VendorA (internal bench)" with a parenthetical link to repro.

jon-eng: Bench nugget: seq=2048 p99: Redwood=740ms, VendorA=2250ms. Warm cache, batching=8, 20k samples. I'll add a short methodology note. Repro snippet: ```bash
python bench/run.py --model redwood-opt --seq 2048 --batch 8 --requests 20000 --seed 13
```

casey-sales: Procurement line to reuse: "Managed serving + rollout controls and audit logs lower procurement and compliance risk vs buying GPUs and building ops." Also propose inbound tag set: [onprem_interest, sla_required, dedicated_request]. SDRs will use these to route.

lina-se: Webinar runbook idea: 9 minutes total  1m elevator, 3m econ slide (batching+caching delta), 4m live demo (traffic + simulated AZ fail -> fallback), 1m CTA. Title idea: "Serving guardrails: proofs that keep LLM features online." Ops can schedule.

ops-bot: Reminder: tentative webinar slot Thu 10am PT. Register speakers by Tue EOD. :calendar:

marta-m: Great. Next steps: Jon paste methodology + link to bench; Priya trim elevator and update bullets; Casey create TCO delta slide & inbound tags; Lina draft demo checklist. Target: publish updated battlecard + 1-slide TCO by Thu EOD. Thanks team! :sparkles:
